exercises.question: A car accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 5 seconds. Find its acceleration.
exercises.question_amharic: አንድ መኪና ከእረፍት ተነስቶ በ 5 ሰከንድ ውስጥ 20 ሜ/ሰ ፍጥነት ላይ ደረሰ። ማጣደፉን ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Initial velocity u = 0, final velocity v = 20 m/s, time t = 5 s.\n2. Compute a = (20 - 0) / 5.\n3. a = 4 m/s².
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Initial velocity u = 0, final velocity v = 20 m/s, time t = 5 s.\n2. Compute a = (20 - 0) / 5.\n3. a = 4 m/s².
